subject: Mutual Plan: launch cadence, evaluation owners, and success criteria
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@vantageai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Plan kickoff — launch cadence, evaluation owners, success criteria

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for agreeing to run a short MAP kickoff today. I want to align on cadence, owners for the evaluation plan, and the success criteria we'll use to make the close decision. Proposed outline:

- Weekly 30-minute checkpoints (Wednesdays 10:00-10:30 PT) for the next 6 weeks
- Primary owners: Vantage AI product (Evan) for requirement sign-off; Redwood engineering (Ben) for integration; Redwood CS (Marissa) for onboarding and prompt sets
- Evaluation artifacts we need from your side: a prioritized use-case list, 200 representative prompts, and the procurement/security questionnaire
- Success criteria (tentative): 95% uptime during evaluations, latency median <= 150ms for 1k token contexts, quality score >= 4.0 on the rubric for top 3 use cases

I've attached a lightweight MAP template and an initial evaluation prompt set to get started. Can you confirm the internal owners at Vantage (product, procurement, legal) and whether the proposed cadence works? If so we'll send a calendar invite and a shared Drive folder.

Thanks,

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

(attachment: MAP-template.xlsx (8KB, spreadsheet))
(attachment: evaluation_prompts.md (4KB, text))

Thanks Jordan — this looks good.

Confirming attendees on our side: Evan Liu (Product), Priya Desai (Data & ML), and I will loop in procurement (procurement@vantageai.com) for the questionnaire. Wednesday 10:00 PT works for a standing check. We'll aim to deliver the 200 prompts and prioritized use-cases by end of day Thursday.

Also attaching our procurement questionnaire — legal may chime in later with redlines.

Best,
Olivia

Great — thanks Olivia.

I'll own the onboarding checklist and will post the shared Drive folder (link below) with:

- MAP template (Jordan's attached copy + our notes)
- Evaluation rubric (quality scoring + latency targets)
- Weekly checkpoint agenda (template)

Ben — can you confirm the Redwood integration owner and whether we need any sample data ingestion guides from Vantage?

Action items so far:
1) Vantage to deliver 200 prompts and prioritized use-cases (Olivia / Evan) — due Thu 08/27 EOD
2) Procurement questionnaire returned (Vantage procurement) — target Fri 08/28
3) Redwood to share Drive + calendar invite (Marissa) — target Wed 08/26
4) Integration owner confirm + list of sample data formats (Ben) — target Wed 08/26

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

Marissa
